prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with neck and back strain after a low-speed head-on collision. The patient had 20 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1059; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury matches the kind and force of the crash well.
- Treatment followed a usual course and tapered off as the patient improved.
- Imaging and exam findings clearly confirm the injury.
- No earlier injury to the same body area is known.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text: The patient presented following a low-speed head-on motor vehicle collision with complaints of neck and low back pain, muscle tightness, and restricted range of motion. The reported mechanism of injury is consistent with the kind and force of the impact, and the presenting symptoms fit that mechanism well. Physical examination documented reduced cervical and lumbar mobility with palpable paraspinal muscle tenderness, and imaging findings clearly confirm the soft tissue injury described. No prior injury or treatment to the same body regions is known from the history obtained. Over twenty visits, care consisted of manual therapy, guided exercise, and home program instruction, following a usual and expected course. Symptoms improved steadily, and visit frequency was reduced as function returned. Billing records reflect single, non-duplicated charges for each service rendered. At discharge, the patient was improving, with residual stiffness expected to resolve with continued home exercise.
